mechanism: Both drugs have anticholinergic properties and are metabolized by CYP2D6; tolterodine may inhibit carvedilol metabolism while carvedilol's beta-blocking effects may be additive with tolterodine's anticholinergic cardiac effects.
action: Monitor heart rate and blood pressure regularly; consider alternative anticholinergic agent or adjust carvedilol dose if significant bradycardia or hypotension develops.
